execution_condition: Root must first confirm successful completed v5 generation and explicitly invoke the frozen plan with --execute; no automatic launch or F32 follow-up.

read_only_checks.authority: Controller requires explicit --execute, requested plan SHA, prepared status and exact self hash before reserving outputs.
read_only_checks.inputs_and_commands: Exact base, engines, comparison binary, both fixed cases, all six argv and protocol environment match; every bound input is verified before each phase and actual after hashes/errors are retained.
read_only_checks.output_exclusion: Fresh output directory required; child stdout/stderr, native dumps and JSON receipts use exclusive creation. q8-control-1 remains absent at audit.
read_only_checks.case_validation: Each successful native dump must have exact 1217308 bytes, fixed JVL2 header, all447 embedded IDs matching its own case, and positions444/447. Finite checks are in the frozen dumpers/comparator previously audited.
read_only_checks.coverage_and_exits: Nonzero exits and missing outputs fail. The frozen plan has exactly four forwards and two comparisons; both metric processes must emit exactly the two full-vocabulary captures, and every phase must complete before completed receipt.
read_only_checks.resources: os.wait4(child.pid) supplies that exact child peak RSS/user/system time. No-child launch/log-open failure leaves null resources; interruption path terminates and reaps the child.
read_only_checks.failure_retention: Returned child result is appended before postchecks; changed/missing input hashes are recorded individually, postcheck failure changes status, phase receipt is saved, then aggregate failure receipt retains all created files. No retry or F32 branch.
read_only_checks.fixtures: Existing no-model receipts and artifact hashes independently checked for missing executable, partial exit7, exit0 without output and stderr-open failure; existing checker uses actual run_phase and wrong-case verify_dump rejection. No duplicate suite run.
read_only_checks.thresholds: Plan specifies three-way signs on unrounded stored margins. Screening interpretation remains separate from correctness.

limits: Scientific scope and selected v5 result are unchanged.
The successful-v5 prerequisite is an explicit root orchestration condition; this diagnostic controller itself does not read v5 completion.
